definitions.explanation: A person who comes to visit a place, home, or institution. Used in both everyday and formal contexts.

examples.japanese: {訪問者|ほうもんしゃ}が{来|き}た。
{本日|ほんじつ}の{訪問者|ほうもんしゃ}は{三名|さんめい}です。
{訪問者|ほうもんしゃ}は{受付|うけつけ}で{記帳|きちょう}してください。
examples.english: Visitors, please sign in at the reception desk.

notes:
A compound noun formed from {訪問|ほうもん} (visit) and {者|しゃ} (person). Refers to anyone who visits a place, whether a home, office, hospital, or website.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {訪問者|ほうもんしゃ}を{迎|むか}える — to welcome a visitor
- {訪問者|ほうもんしゃ}{用|よう}の{駐車場|ちゅうしゃじょう} — visitor parking
- {訪問者|ほうもんしゃ}{数|すう} — number of visitors
- {不審|ふしん}な{訪問者|ほうもんしゃ} — suspicious visitor

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {来客|らいきゃく} — guest, caller (more formal, often for business)
- {客|きゃく} — guest, customer (broader, more casual)
- {来訪者|らいほうしゃ} — visitor (slightly more formal synonym)
